titulo_fr: Lire un débat contemporain : Observer les formes
titulo_es: Read a contemporary debate: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It restrengthens the debate and separates data, assessment and proposal into texts on a current subject. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It restrengthens the debate and separates data, assessment and proposal into texts on a current subject. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.
Point of attention: The verbal powers and the reserve markers indicate how much each source supports an affirmation. In this fragment, «débat» means «debate».

frases.fr: Les usagers interrogés estiment que ces horaires faciliteraient les études, notamment pour les personnes salariées.
frases.es: Los usuarios entrevistados consideran que esos horarios facilitarían los estudios, especialmente para quienes trabajan.
frases.en: Interviewees consider that such hours would facilitate the studies, especially for those who work.

frases.fr: Le personnel exprime des réserves, faute d'effectifs suffisants pour assurer les permanences supplémentaires.
frases.es: El personal expresa reservas por falta de plantilla suficiente para cubrir los turnos adicionales.
frases.en: Staff express reservations for lack of staff sufficient to cover additional shifts.

frases.fr: Le débat sur les bibliothèques ouvertes le soir porte autant sur l'accès aux services que sur les conditions de travail.
frases.es: El debate sobre abrir las bibliotecas por la noche trata tanto del acceso a los servicios como de las condiciones laborales.
frases.en: The debate on opening up libraries at night deals with both access to services and working conditions.
